clusters.name: Teodor's death, 1978–1979
clusters.reason: Around Teodor's death in January 1978, within the following year: Delphine stopped cooking and went to her daughter Odette's every evening; Duncan took night shifts and distanced from his wife; Anton began drinking at lunch with a warning at work; his separation from Celeste followed in August; Odette lay awake over her mother and Anton; Callum had ear infections all winter. These shifts pass from one person to the next in the months after the death, and Delphine's functioning rose in May 1979 when she took a job at the library.

clusters.name: Odette's bed rest in pregnancy, 1984–1984
clusters.reason: Around Odette ordered to bed in March 1984: Hazel came every morning to keep the house and overfunctioned; Duncan argued with his mother over how she kept it; Callum stammered again after a year free of it; Maren's anxiety rose at night; Ines was born in September. These shifts are close together in the months around the pregnancy and its end, with Hazel's move into the household and the conflict it opened.

clusters.name: Hazel's Parkinson's diagnosis, 1986–1996
clusters.reason: Around Hazel's diagnosis in September 1986, over the following decade: Ambrose took over her cooking and appointments and overfunctioned; Duncan phoned his father nightly for news; Hazel fell and walked with a frame; a new medicine steadied her briefly; Duncan and Lyle argued over who should help; Duncan's chest pains began; Hazel could no longer dress herself; Odette took her to clinic twice weekly and overfunctioned; Mavis came one week in four to nurse her sister; Duncan drank most evenings; Pearl had panic spells at the wheel; Hazel had good months and declining months; Ambrose gave up his workshop and hardly left her side; Duncan fought with Odette over his evenings at his parents' house. The shifts build slowly over years, each step with only partial relief between them, until Hazel moved to nursing care in June 1997 and Duncan cut his drinking back.

clusters.name: Callum's leaving home, 1999–2000
clusters.reason: Around Callum leaving for a job in the mines in May 1999: Duncan and Callum argued most nights over the plans; Odette could not settle at the thought of him so far away; Duncan missed days at work and sat up late in the garage; Ines skipped school most of that autumn; Odette took Ines with her everywhere; Ines was back at school and passed her exams by August 2000. The shifts move from conflict between the men to Odette's anxiety and Duncan's fall in functioning, with Odette turning toward Ines and the period settling as Ines returned to school.

clusters.name: Hazel's death, 2003–2003
clusters.reason: Around Hazel's death in January 2003: Maren could not sleep more than a few hours; she stopped going to the bookshop and was let go in May; she went out only after dark, dreading buses and crowded shops; she took a job at the garden centre and slept through the night again by November. All shifts in these months are yours, and no one else's shows then.
